title: Robur the Conqueror
creator: Victor Appleton
imageAlt: REPLACE: cover illustration of Tom Swift and His Electric Rifle
summary: Robur the Conqueror, which was published in 1886, demonstrated Verne’s creative foray into aircraft. The Albatros, a heavier-than-air flying aircraft propelled by multiple propellers, was introduced in the novel. During a time when balloon transport dominated the aviation industry, Verne’s story provided a forward-thinking alternative that foresaw future innovations.

tech.name: TASER
tech.description: An electroshock weapon developed by NASA researcher Jack Cover, who named it after the novel: Thomas A. Swift's Electric Rifle. Check dates against a source before publishing; accounts vary.
